nom: SUNDAY RILEY B3 Nice 10% Niacinamide Serum

avis.texte: This product did give me a couple of pimples for the first 2-3 weeks that i used it. Clearly it wasnt bad enough because i continued to give this product a try. But the end result is so good! My pores and skin look smoother! Ill keep repurchasing.

avis.titre: I cannot go without this product
avis.texte: I first tried this product on a whim because it was on a yellow tag sale at my Ulta. I fell in love instantly. I notice a difference when I don't use this product. If I run out and have to go without it for a few weeks or days, my cystic acne shows back up. No single product has ever done this much for my skin. It keeps breakouts at bay, and helps so much with acne scars and dark spots. The smell is a little different, and may bother some people, but it makes no difference to me. The only bad thing about this product is that it's so expensive. Use it every night as long as it lasts. This product will make you broke but your skin will be beautiful.
I have acne scars that Ive been insecure about for a long time, but I do notice that this product is improving them. Im on my third bottle!

I actually really love this product. I first tried it as a sample maybe a year or more ago, and yes the color is brown. I'm not sure why that's the number one point on everyone's negative review. Niacinamide is a harsh product to put on your face. You very well could have a reaction. So keep that in mind. Maybe use it when you have 2-3 days you can stay home just in case it does give you some redness. But it does reduce blown out/large pores some. I don't think there's any real miracle solution to rid them completely, faces have texture. Of all the Sunday Riley products I really love this one the most.
Really helped my acne scars in a very short amount of time. Worth the price

I received this in an Allure Beauty Box. As others mentioned, it does have an unattractive brown color. This wasn't a deal breaker for me initially. However, when my face became irritated and itchy after only a few days of use I stopped using it. I'm glad I didn't pay full price. If you have sensitive skin, this product may not be for you.
Smells like bad liquid. I almost wondered if there is any bug in it. Hardly find anything like this. Nothing like what's pictured on the product page.

I have been using this product for about 3 weeks now, and absolutely LOVE IT! I use it every morning and night, and have noticed a huge difference in my complexion. I do not wear makeup to work, as I am a pre-k teacher, and I sweat more than anything, and this product has been a GAME CHANGER for making me feel much more confident in wearing 0 products on my face for work. It has reduced my redness, smoothed my skin texture, and has made me feel so glowly. It has a very weightless feel, and smooths in so nicely. The only con would be the color- it is quite brown/green, but to me it has no smell (and with the results I'm getting, I don't mind rubbing booger colored serum on my face).

I wanted to like this Serum but not noticing any change in my skin yet. The main problem is the serum comes out in a terrible brown color! That is bothersome to put brown serum product on your face & skin. Doubtful I will ever buy it again.

I really was hopeful for this serum….i mean for this price, who wouldn't be? Right from the first pump i knew something was off…it had a weird smell and the color was the color of mucus 🤢. But I thought….well maybe this is ok and applied a thin layer. The next morning, my face had an orange tint. So back to the store it went. Really hope Sunday Riley can fix the formula because this is apparently a common problem.
My skin has never looked better. The texture and tone has improved so much. It literally shrinks your pores.

After incorporating this product into my routine, my skin is visibly clearer and more radiant, with a noticeable decrease in oiliness. My pores also appear smaller, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking to improve their skin texture. Overall great product.

This stuff is awful i never break out and this gave me awful bumps everywhere! Its been a week and stilk has not gone away…Everything sunday riley makes breaks me out they use essential oils and fragrance . Big no no for skin

I've had decently bad acne all of my life up into my 30s, and once I started using this product my acne has pretty much disappeared (save for maybe one pimple during periods) and my scarring has disappeared.

I wasn't sure how I felt about using a standalone niacinimide, but after trying I love this serum. I love that it has resveratrol and egcg in it also, which are great antioxidants besides vit c. I feel this is a great serum for antiaging and helps reduce dryness and counteracts my oily t-zone. My skin is smooth and appears clear. Love the smooth texture of product, really feels luxurious. I do use other sunday riley products and they all compliment each other well.

Love this so much!!! An associate recommended this to me while shopping. Im acne prone and oliy skin my entire life. I finally find something that works and is true to its claim!! Buy this i know its 65 bucks but its worth it! A little goes a along way, on my second bottle and last me 2 months. Im glowing and finally comfortable in my skin!

avis.titre: Redness reducer & pore improved (AND I have sensitive skin!)
avis.texte: I love this. I alternate between this in the morning and Peach and Lily Glass Skin serum at night. I have pretty sensitive skin. Like, can't tolerate neutrogena sensitive skin. So I cautiously purchased my first bottle. it goes on really nicely and is fairly absorbant into the skin within a minute or two. Almost to the bottom of bottle #2.

avis.titre: if you struggle with visible pores.....YOU. NEED. THIS.
avis.texte: I never leave reviews, ever. If I love a product, I tell friends and family and move on with my life including the aforementioned product. but this?! I'm shouting it from the rooftops. Since i've gotten older (27, F) I have had issues with my pores becoming more visible, cheeks always red, uneven patches of skin, etc. I have tried countless products to help reduce this with little success. I went to Ulta specifically looking for something new to try to help target these problem areas and stumbled across this little miracle in a bottle. I asked the cashier when checking out if she had used it and she told me "You're gonna love it so much you'll wish you didn't because you won't be able to live without it again!" BOY, was she right!! Y'all.....the gasp I gusped after applying the serum. This product instantly reduced my pore visibilty and helped with redness. My skin has NEVER looked so smooth and radiant! My skin is smooth and my under eye wrinkles are diminishing. I am AMAZED. I use it every single day. I will never go without it again! TRUST ME, it is well worth the price.
Obsessed with this! On my second bottle and already have two more bottles in my cabinet. This has helped with my rosacea and feels great! Definitely 100% buying this again and again!
Made a huge difference in my reddness prone skin. I'm currently on my third bottle. I will never stop using it.

I was excited to try B3 Nice as I love C.E.O and A+ unfortunately it burned my forehead when testing a small area. It also left a small scar from the burn. The sample bottle I received was also a strange brown color. That should have been a warning not to put it on my skin. Threw the sample out and will not use this product again.

I received a sample of this in a previous order and saw results in just a few days. Decided to purchase the bottle. It calmed redness on my face, makes my skin smoother, and definitely shrinking pore visibility.
I've been using this for about three weeks and I've noticed a difference in my pores. My pores are large and this has minimized them quite a bit. I'm a big fan of Sunday Riley's products.

This is my second bottle of B3 Nice and I mainly got it because the first bottle I had was a brownish color - not the light purple colir advertised. I assumed the product went bad. I get my new bottle today and it has a different dispenser (first bottle had the dropper) but it is still the same gross brown color. Is this normal? If so, they need to update their marketing so consumers won't think they got a bad product. Now I am left wondering if I should return it or not.
I love this serum. If you want something to even out your complexion, brighten your skin and shrink pores- USE THIS. I use it in the AM before my vitamin C.

avis.titre: If you buy one thing for your face, buy this
avis.texte: My pores were getting larger with age - like crater sized. One day in Ulta, I picked this up and decided to try it. Good Genes did fabulous things for my skin so I figured, why not? Just buy it. That's my review. It's amazing. Pores are virtually undetectable, foundation's a breeze to apply, skin looks amazing every day.
This did nothing for my skin, I suffer from Hormonal acne and clogged pores and redness + inflammation all over. I keep trying to consistently use but it doesnt do anything at all

I usually stay away from products with niacinamide but this serum blow me away. I had a really bad experience with LRP & Paulas choice niacinmide and was weary about trying this but after slowly incorporating once a week it has answered all of my prayers and it is now a staple in my nightly routine.

I rarely do reviews. But i love this stuff. I never feel pretty without makeup because of my uneven skin tone. This stuff has completely transformed my skin. Its no longer splotchy and uneven toned and I even started putting it on my chest which ube truggled with texture. Its a definite splurge and i wish it was cheaper. But ill save my pennies go continue buying it!

This has made a noticeable difference on my oily complexion. Less redness, more even toned and no breakouts. Plays well with my other products. The difference is noticeable enough that i will be repurchasing!

I received a sample bottle of Sunday Riley's Niacinamide serum and was so excited to try it as I love other products from this brand. I used a small amount before going to bed and I woke up with what looks like a sunburn. My skin is red, irritated, itchy and tight. I'm using a cortisone cream to try and tame it. If you have skin that is sensitive, you might want to do a patch test before using.

I typically try different products all the time because I never really love something enough to repurchase, but this product I will be repurchasing. I bought this on a whim at Ulta and have only been using it for a few days (day and night) and I already notice a difference in dark spots, sun damage, and pore size. It's out-performing my retinols actually.

avis.titre: I will buy this again and again until they make a better o…
avis.texte: I received this full size from the Allure Box in May. Used it for a month, tried other similar products, but none other compares to this BeNice. Smaller pores, glowy skin, and more even texture. Love all the Sunday Riley products, and this, as well as the Luna Sleeping oil are standouts.

avis.titre: Worked better than my RX cream
avis.texte: This one really impressed me. Ive been on a prescription cream for months for dark spot correction and they barely put a dent. I recieved this in my Allure beauty box and was so pleasantly surprised to see significant fading of my dark sun spots within weeks. This worked where my derm prescribed cream couldn't. I'll keep anteing up the cost of this serum. It works.
Glides on the skin beautifully and feels so good! Another WINNER from Sunday Riley!

I received this in my Allure beauty box. I used it twice a day for a good while and my skin looked and felt great. Then all the sudden it started causing welts, redness and scaliness. I didn't think it could be this product so I stopped all products until my skin calmed down. I tried using this product again and the same thing happened. This brand in general causes a lot of irritation in my skin unfortunately. I think the products work but at a huge cost. I don't even consider myself to have sensitive skin. I can't imagine how this would be for someone with actual sensitive skin.

I received a full bottle of this in my Allure subscription box and used it for over a month. I didn't want to buy another because of the price. Once I ran out it only took a few days to see a difference. Without it I had breakouts and my skin was much more dull. I bought a bottle because it makes me glow and my skin feels so much better.

avis.titre: This is the best daytime serum!!
avis.texte: I received this full-size product in my Allure beauty box. Have used it every day for a month, and notice a real difference in my pores(smaller), and skin tone is more even.. It is non-pilling when layered with my other Sunday Riley products. Definitely recommend this serum…A+
Softens and smooths texture and hydrates dry patches without being greasy.
